blocks.html: Inspection shall consist of visual examination during or after manufacture, fabrication, assembly or pressure tests as appropriate. Supplementary types of nondestructive inspection techniques, such as magnetic-particle, radiographic, ultrasonic, etc., shall not be required unless specifically listed herein or in the engineering design. All inspections shall be performed in accordance with Section 108
